description: SIM94 — RIFT DESI Y1 BAO Refit. Replaces BOSS+eBOSS (SIM87) with DESI Year 1 BAO data (arXiv:2404.03002, Adame et al. 2024). 13 data points across 7 redshift bins (BGS, LRG x2, LRG+ELG, ELG, QSO, Lya). Full block-diagonal covariance with DM-DH off-diagonal correlations from Table 1 of DESI Y1. Tests: (1) BAO-only RIFT fit, (2) joint DESI+CMB fit, (3) Lambda0 sensitivity scan.

data.covariance: Block-diagonal: within-bin DM-DH off-diagonal from published rho; between-bin blocks set to zero (independent survey footprints / sub-volumes).
data.note_vs_sim87: SIM87 used 12 BOSS+eBOSS+Lyalpha points. SIM94 uses 13 DESI Y1 points. Overlap at z~0.51, z~1.49 (QSO), z~2.33 (Lya). DESI errors are ~2-5x smaller than BOSS at matched redshifts.

lambda0_scan.note: Scan chi2(Lambda0) at DESI+CMB joint best-fit (H0, Omega_m, rd). Compare sensitivity to SIM91 (BOSS+eBOSS scan).

expected_outcomes.note: DESI Y1 has ~3-5x smaller errors than BOSS at matched redshifts. Expect: (1) RIFT fits DESI with chi2/dof~1 (like SIM87). (2) Lambda0 still unconstrained — G_eff deviation is ~16 ppm at Lambda0=0.003, far below DESI sensitivity. (3) Best-fit (H0, Omega_m) near SIM90 joint fit. (4) Lambda0 sensitivity scan flat (Dchi2 << 1 across 0-0.1) as in SIM91.
